dispositions.topic_text: Handling and timeout policy for stalled, disconnected, or prematurely ended upload-head reads
dispositions.what: How long a listener waits for a request's bytes — an upload's head among them — before it closes the connection, the same for every request of both surfaces: a read timeout of instance_lifecycle's listeners, with its value a data-provider constant; a head cut by it, ended or failed before it is complete gives no CSRF value and is refused at stage (1), nothing kept.
